name: Henri, le Chat Noir
bio: Henri is cinema's foremost feline existentialist. Narrating his ennui in subtitled French, he turned domestic tedium into art-house gold. Critics call him 'the Sartre of the litter box'; Henri calls the critics 'imbeciles, like the white idiot who shares my home.'
awards: Golden Kitty Award, Internet Cat Video Festival (2012)
